Surgery Information.Surgery Findings: 5 overlapping stents placed across the malignant duodenal obstruction, evidence of carcinomatosis of the jejunum

Additional Comments: The patient, a 74-year-old male with pancreatic adenocarcinoma, has experienced significant complications related to his cancer, including a partial bowel obstruction at the ligament of Treitz and peritoneal carcinomatosis with omental implants. He underwent an EGD with the placement of five overlapping stents to address a malignant duodenal obstruction, and a subsequent CT scan showed resolution of the intestinal obstruction. However, he continues to experience moderate ascites and discomfort potentially related to the stents. His recent bilirubin level was elevated at 3.5 mg/dL, and a CT scan on 08/25/16 indicated a small bowel obstruction. Despite these interventions, the patient’s condition has progressed, and discussions have been initiated regarding transitioning to palliative care.
